title: Certificate of Participation – Sustainable Industrial Design BootCamp 2025
Introduction to Embedded Machine Learning
description: Machine learning (ML) allows us to teach computers to make predictions and decisions based on data and learn from experiences. In recent years, incredible optimizations have been made to machine learning algorithms, software frameworks, and embedded hardware. Thanks to this, running deep neural networks and other complex machine learning algorithms is possible on low-power devices like microcontrollers.

title: Master of Survival Winner
description:
Earth has many unique places where making new machines or inventions can be more difficult. Extreme temperatures, sand, water—everything can be a challenge for electronic components. However, there are ways to make them more durable and useful in those environments.

With rapid changes in temperature around the globe, people need to adapt in every possible way. That's why we are seeking new ideas to tackle both new and old challenges of living here.

Any ideas? Focus on those elements:

Theme of survival—It is about what can be used to make living easier in harsh environments. Also, it's about devices that will withstand extreme conditions. 

Limited access—Survival presents new challenges. Access to energy can be almost impossible in the wild, so maybe it's better to use sunlight, water, or motion to power devices. Nature can be a friend or foe to electronic components.

Climate, Weather, Environment—The current official highest recorded air temperature on Earth is 56.7°C (134.1°F). Is it possible for something to work in such hot weather? Also, what is one of the biggest enemies of electronics? W-A-T-E-R. So, protection from the sea, rivers, or rain is a must for our projects to survive
